description:
You are a clinical neuropsychologist at a memory clinic. Your department has decided to digitize the episodic memory subscale of the Addenbrooke's Cognitive Examination III (ACE-III; Mioshi et al., 2006) for tablet-based administration. Using PsychoPy Builder, create an experiment that implements the three-word registration and delayed recall procedure used in the ACE-III.

The experiment must include: (1) a learning phase that presents the three target words (Lemon, Key, Ball) one at a time, followed by an interference task; (2) a free recall phase where the participant types their response via keyboard; (3) a recognition phase that reads items from a conditions file, with the participant pressing 'y' for yes and 'n' for no; (4) a code component that tallies correct free-recall and recognition hits, storing scores in the data file; (5) a final scoring summary screen.

The conditions file for the recognition phase must be saved to:
  /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/conditions/ace3_recognition.csv

It must contain exactly 12 rows with columns for the word, an 'is_target' flag (1=target, 0=foil), and a 'correct_response' column ('y' for targets, 'n' for foils). The three target words are Lemon, Key, and Ball (standard ACE-III stimuli).

Save the experiment to:
  /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/ace3_episodic_memory.psyexp
